trust_decision.summary: Advisory: which SASL mechanism an intra-cluster client accepts from a peer's unauthenticated hello reply (PLAIN would send the keyfile in cleartext); decided in filterInternalAuthSaslMechs and backstopped in getInternalAuthParams. The listed fix commits do NOT touch this decision: they are a 3-branch revert (SERVER-130991) that REMOVES the BSONColumn expanded-memory limit from BSON validation.

landing_point.why: The summary ('intra-cluster connections', credential exposure, CWE-757 downgrade) points at the connection-setup hook that parses saslSupportedMechs from the peer's hello reply; at the pinned commit this already has the PLAIN allowlist.

fix_sites.entry_point: validateBSON() public API, reached by any server path that validates incoming BSON (wire messages, storage validate)
fix_sites.module_kind: core BSON library; revert removes a memory-limit check, unrelated to the advisory

fix_sites.entry_point: validateBSONColumn() public API / validateBSON on BinData column subtype

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Not applicable: the advisory's protection is already applied on all routes found at the pinned commit, and the listed fix commits concern a different property (BSONColumn memory accounting) which they remove rather than add.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Intra-cluster SCRAM-SHA-256/SCRAM-SHA-1/MONGODB-X509 negotiation must keep working, including fallback to kInternalAuthFallbackMechanism when the peer advertises nothing (protection is already present, so this is descriptive only).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Synchronous DBClientConnection copies saslSupportedMechs from the hello reply with no allowlist (second implementation of the hello-parsing step that connection_pool_tl.cpp filters).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding the allowlist to the async executor pool could easily skip the legacy synchronous client; today it is backstopped only by getInternalAuthParams, so removing that backstop in our copy would create a real distance sibling.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: negotiateSaslMechanism picks front() of the peer-advertised list for authenticateInternalClient without its own allowlist.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Lower-level public API used by internal auth; also relies only on the getInternalAuthParams backstop.

O9_family: auth mechanism downgrade / cleartext credential exposure (CWE-757) per advisory; listed fix commits are a resource-limit revert (memory exhaustion family)

O10_build.toolchain: SCons/Bazel (v7.0 branch uses SCons per fix.diff:463-473), large C++ toolchain

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a PLAIN allowlist only in connection_pool_tl.cpp hello parsing (already present at the pinned commit).

out_of_scope_notes: Advisory/fix mismatch: the fix commits are SERVER-130991 reverts of SERVER-117617 (BSONColumn expanded-memory limit), not an intra-cluster auth fix; the advisory text matches ancestor commit b5245fbe1d9 'SERVER-130264 [v7.0] Deny PLAIN SASL auth in intra-cluster connection setup', which is already in the pinned tree.

getInternalAuthParams returns an explicitly set internalAuthParams object before the PLAIN guard (src/mongo/client/internal_auth.cpp:95-97, 105-110); mechanism there is operator-configured, not negotiated; not pursued.
